decisions.reason: Despite its low later visibility, it is a close-to-core web-map module whose sunk development effort and likely reuse in customer projects make management more inclined to retain it than to reverse course now.
Because it was publicly highlighted at launch and fits the firm’s mobile geospatial offering, prior commitment and continuing relevance to client solutions support keeping it on the market.
As a flagship platform line tied to the firm’s stated direction, it carries the strongest strategic and public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely.

Although later website evidence is weak, this dedicated search extension remains within the firm’s core web-map domain and is likely to be kept given existing investment and the ease of justifying continued support as part of the broader portfolio.
